source: rime-cantonese (CanCLID, CC BY 4.0): essay-cantonese.txt frequencies, jyut6ping3 word and character readings (main reading per character)

fields.zipf: Zipf of the syllable's token frequency summed over all words containing it
fields.homophones: distinct characters read with this toned syllable in reference-eligible words
fields.gap: tonal gap: legal syllable with a tone it never carries (checked syllables only take tones 1, 3, 6)
fields.rare: reading seen in fewer than 3 reference-eligible words: accepted as input, never generated
